events.title: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, last native Prince of Wales, is killed
events.description: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd was killed near Cilmeri during Edward I's conquest of Wales. Wales lost its independence, and in 1301 Edward gave the title Prince of Wales to his own son.
events.html: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd was killed near Cilmeri during Edward I's conquest of Wales. Wales lost its independence, and in 1301 Edward gave the title Prince of Wales to his own son.

events.title: James II flees London
events.description: As William of Orange advanced, James II slipped out of Whitehall and dropped the Great Seal into the Thames. Caught at Faversham, he escaped to France later that month; Parliament treated his flight as abdication.

events.title: Louis XVI goes on trial before the National Convention
events.description: The deposed king, now called Louis Capet, appeared before the National Convention to answer charges of treason. He was convicted and guillotined in January 1793.
events.html: The deposed king, now called Louis Capet, appeared before the National Convention to answer charges of treason. He was convicted and guillotined in January 1793.

events.title: Edward VIII abdicates to marry Wallis Simpson
events.description: The abdication took legal effect, and that evening Edward broadcast that he could not reign 'without the help and support of the woman I love'. His brother succeeded as George VI.
events.html: The abdication took legal effect, and that evening Edward broadcast that he could not reign 'without the help and support of the woman I love'. His brother succeeded as George VI.

events.title: Germany and Italy declare war on the United States
events.description: Four days after Pearl Harbor, Hitler and Mussolini declared war on the United States. The decision brought American power fully into the war in Europe.
